design: Existing plain white Arial single-column human-readable blog article. No framework or reviewer-control UI.
future_read_only_view: Authenticate exact metadata.normalized.json and zenodo-record.raw.json; compare complete_metadata and complete_actual_file_objects with the raw original. Read id/metadata/created/updated/files from the actual raw JSON in memory only; never create sources/record.json or other aliases. Preserve the complete original normalized object separately.

receipt.schema: Original complete receipt has four files entries: two actual published objects, plus versions.raw.json and latest.raw.json endpoint receipts with actual_file_object=null. Each original entry retains filename/requested_url/actual_file_object/status/final_url/bytes/md5/sha256 and all other fields. No synthetic name/url/http_status aliases or invented fetch data are written.

receipt_consumer: For public asset resolution, select only entries whose actual_file_object is not null. Use filename, requested_url, actual_file_object and status directly in a temporary authenticated read-only view. versions.raw.json/latest.raw.json are actual endpoint transport receipts, not extra deposited/public files; preserve them whole in provenance. Do not mutate or silently discard original receipt entries or manufacture HTTP/field aliases.
abstract_normalization: The finite explicit M/n/n≥1/binomial-exponent normalization in prepare_editorial.normalize, cross-checked against the whole frozen original abstract and PDF page1.

metadata_requirements.description: A global positive-Hessian realization of smooth statistical manifolds with a proper embedding, explicit finite dimension and the prescribed ordered dual connections.
metadata_requirements.citation_title: Global Hessian realizations of statistical manifolds
metadata_requirements.abstract: Let M be a smooth, Hausdorff, second-countable n-manifold without boundary, with a positive Riemannian metric and two prescribed, mutually dual, torsion-free connections. For n≥1 we construct a proper smooth embedding into an open subset of ℝ^{binomial(2n+4,3)} carrying one smooth positive Hessian potential. Orthogonal projection of the ambient standard connection and its metric dual induces exactly the ordered pair of given connections. Finite polynomial features provide a smooth global scalar third-jet lifting; a variable tubular neighborhood and a pointwise Schur estimate provide ambient positivity without compactness or uniform bounds. For a general Riemannian dual pair, vanishing of both torsions is necessary and sufficient for such realization. This supplies a self-contained answer in the smooth statistical category to the historical dually flat realization question. Historical novelty and present openness are not asserted; important prior constructions and unresolved primary-source coverage are specified.

complete_original_verdicts: promotion.reviews.*.verdict stores the entire custom original object; exact root_authority_entry and root_clearance_record remain separate. No default-PASS conversion of originals.
public_exclusions: No internal audit replay, dates, counts, hashes, source/cache custody or reviewer narrative. Mathematical scope, earlier-work credit and unresolved priority limits remain public.
